The Travelling Trader Quest

General

Aliases

Rashid Quest, Travelling Trader Quest

Quest Log

Friends and Traders

Requirements

Premium

✓

Level

0
(50+ recommended)

Other

Version

8.10
December 11, 2007
Christmas Update 2007

Status

Active
See also: Quests

Legend

Rashid is searching experienced traders, so he can buy their goods. You have to pass a test to prove yourself a worthy trader, one new task each day in a whole week.

Location

Svargrond, Liberty Bay, Port Hope, Ankrahmun, Darashia, Edron and Carlin. Missions also take you to Outlaw Camp, Kazordoon, Ab'Dendriel and the inner parts of Tiquanda.

Dangers

  • Monday: Smugglers for a Deer Trophy.
  • Tuesday: Smugglers, Wild Warriors, Bandits and maybe lured Minotaurs.
  • Wednesday: Nomads and Tiquanda creatures.
  • Friday: Dwarves and/or Geo-Elementals for Iron Ores.
  • Saturday: Quaras to fill a Goldfish Bowl.

Reward

Ability to trade with Rashid, achievement Recognised Trader.

Requirements

Players must start the quest on Monday (after server save).

Item Requirements

  • 1 Deer Trophy
  • 3 Iron Ores
  • 1 Goldfish Bowl
  • 1500 gp + travel money

Method

After each mission, players must wait until the next day (after server save) to continue with the next part.

First Mission, Monday

Rashid will be in Svargrond, at Dankwart's tavern (here (32210, 31158, 7)). Talk to him, ask for a mission, and he will ask if you are interested in becoming a recognized trader. He warns you that you will have to travel a lot, and asks if you are willing to try. Say yes, and he will explain the details to you, and ask if you understood. Answer yes, and he will ask for a Deer Trophy. Once you obtain one, come back to him and say mission, yes, and the quest log will update.

Second Mission, Tuesday

For this mission you will need 600 oz of free capacity to carry a Heavy Package. Rashid will be in Liberty Bay on Tuesday, in Lyonel's tavern (here (32303, 32835, 7)). Ask him for a mission, say yes, yes and he will ask you to get him a package from Willard, on Edron (here (33212, 31795, 6)). Go to Edron, where Willard is the weapon dealer. Find him and ask him about the package for Rashid. He will tell you that he forgot about it, and ask if you can keep it a secret from Rashid, and pick up the package from Snake Eye in Outlaw Camp (here (32657, 32190, 8)). Answer yes. Go to Snake Eye, and ask about the package for Rashid, and he will let you open the flashing door. Get the package and deliver to Rashid in Liberty Bay by saying mission, yes, and the quest log will update.

Third Mission, Wednesday

Rashid will be in Port Hope on Wednesdays, in Clyde's tavern (here (32577, 32753, 7)). Ask Rashid for a mission, say yes, yes, and he will ask you to buy a Scarab Cheese from Miraia on Darashia (here (33239, 32484, 7)). Travel to Darashia and buy the cheese for 100 gp, by saying scarab cheese, yes to Miraia. You must be fast in delivering the cheese to Rashid, because after 30 minutes it turns into a Mouldy Cheese. Also, beware that the cheese is edible. If you lose the cheese somehow, you can buy another one from Miraia. You cannot use boats, so you must make your way to Port Hope on foot following this path from Ankrahmun to Port Hope.

Rashid will not accept the cheese if you:

  • buy it before speaking to him
  • send the cheese by parcel
  • use Temple Teleport Scroll to Port Hope

After reaching Rashid, say mission, yes, to finish the delivery, and the quest log will update. If you have previously finished the Ice Delivery mission of The Explorer Society Quest, you will also receive the Just in Time achievement.

Fourth Mission, Thursday

Rashid will be in Ankrahmun on Thursdays, in Arito's tavern, one floor above the post office. Talk to Rashid, say mission, yes, yes, and he will ask you to buy him a Fine Vase. Travel to Ab'Dendriel and find Briasol (here (32634, 31667, 8)) and buy the vase from him by saying fine vase, yes. You will need 1,000 gp to buy one. Note that this vase is very fragile, you must not touch it (do not move it on your Backpack). If the vase breaks, you can buy another. Go back to Rashid and deliver the vase to him by saying mission, yes, and the quest log will update.

Fifth Mission, Friday

Rashid will be in Darashia on Fridays, in Miraia's tavern. Ask Rashid for mission, say yes, yes, and he will ask you to use your trading skills to buy a Crimson Sword from Uzgod, on Kazordoon (here (32661, 31895, 9)). He wants you to buy it for 400 gp or less, it must not be cheap, and the quality must be perfect. Go to Kazordoon and find Uzgod, the weapon dealer. Ask him for a Crimson Sword, he will say he does not have any to sell. Ask him to forge one for you, he will ask if you are joking with him, answer no. He will set a high price, and ask you if you accept, answer no. He will offer you a cheap sword for 300 gp, answer no again. He will then ask you to give him 3 Iron Ores and 250 gps for a good Crimson Sword, now you can answer yes. Take back the sword to Rashid on Darashia, saying mission, yes. The quest log will be updated. If you make a mistake, you are able to reset the mission by buying a Crimson Sword and offering it to Rashid. This will allow you to reset the mission and try again right after.

Sixth Mission, Saturday

Rashid will be in Edron on Saturdays, in Mirabell's tavern, one floor above the post office and bank. Ask him for mission, say yes, yes, and he will ask you for a Goldfish Bowl. You can obtain this before you talk to him, and just deliver it. If you do not have one, you can buy an empty bowl on any furniture shopkeeper. After that, you must go to Calassa or the Sunken Quarter in Yalahar (here (32981, 31190, 13), here (32932, 31187, 10), or here (32941, 31134, 13)) to get a goldfish inside your bowl. If you cannot enter Calassa or access Yalahar, you can ask a friend to get it to you, or buy from another player. After you have the item, talk to Rashid and say mission, yes, to deliver the bowl and the quest log will be updated.

Final Mission, Sunday

Rashid will be in the Carlin depot on Sundays, one floor above. If you have done all his previous tasks, just ask him about mission. He will declare you as one of his recognized traders, and you will be able to trade with him anytime. You will also receive the achievement Recognised Trader.
